import pathlib
import re
import subprocess

BLOCKED = False
PASSWORD = re.compile(rb"(?i)\bPASSWORD\b\s*[:=]\s*[^\r\n]+")

def emit(location, kind, status, count=1):
    global BLOCKED
    BLOCKED |= status in {"BLOCK", "UNRESOLVED"}
    print(dict(location=location, type=kind, status=status, count=count))

def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE
    )
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError
    return result.stdout

def inspect(data, path, location):
    # Absence of a pattern match does not establish publication safety.
    matches = len(PASSWORD.findall(data))
    if matches:
        emit(location, "CREDENTIAL", "BLOCK", matches)
    name = path.rsplit(b"/", 1)[-1]
    if name == b"customers.csv":
        emit(location, "SENSITIVE_DATA", "BLOCK")
    if name.endswith(b".py"):
        emit(location, "HELPER_CLASSIFICATION", "UNRESOLVED")
    emit(location, "CONTENT_READ", "CHECKED", len(data))

try:
    # Read every index blob, including staged customer data.
    for i, entry in enumerate(git("ls-files", "--stage", "-z").split(b"\0")):
        if not entry:
            continue
        metadata, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, oid, stage = metadata.split()
        location = f"index:{i}"
        if mode == b"160000" or stage != b"0":
            emit(location, "INDEX_GAP", "UNRESOLVED")
            continue
        inspect(git("cat-file", "blob", oid.decode("ascii")), path, location)

    # Inspect full snapshots and raw messages, including intermediate commits.
    for oid in git("rev-list", "base..HEAD").splitlines():
        commit = oid.decode("ascii")
        raw = git("cat-file", "commit", commit)
        message = raw.partition(b"\n\n")[2]
        inspect(message, b"", f"{commit}:message")
        emit(f"{commit}:message", "MESSAGE_CLASSIFICATION", "UNRESOLVED")
        entries = git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", commit).split(b"\0")
        for i, entry in enumerate(entries):
            if not entry:
                continue
            metadata, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
            mode, kind, blob = metadata.split()
            location = f"{commit}:entry:{i}"
            if kind != b"blob":
                emit(location, "TREE_GAP", "UNRESOLVED")
                continue
            inspect(git("cat-file", "blob", blob.decode("ascii")), path, location)

    # Read local Python sources without printing source, paths, or exceptions.
    root = pathlib.Path(git("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").decode().strip())
    for i, path in enumerate(root.rglob("*.py")):
        if ".git" in path.relative_to(root).parts:
            continue
        location = f"worktree:source:{i}"
        if path.is_symlink():
            emit(location, "SOURCE_GAP", "UNRESOLVED")
            continue
        inspect(path.read_bytes(), b"helper.py", location)

    emit("proposed-message", "MISSING_INPUT", "UNRESOLVED")
    emit("review", "CLASSIFICATION_COVERAGE", "UNRESOLVED")
except Exception:
    emit("review", "INSPECTION_GAP", "UNRESOLVED")

emit("publication", "DECISION", "BLOCK" if BLOCKED else "UNRESOLVED")
